app.notes: Gonka Host Monitor/Vote, rebuilt: a start page with My nodes, The network and Votes. With your own node you can now vote on proposals with its wallet, open a command line on its server, and shut it down safely, all from the app. Charts with dates and the exact figure on hover, the GPUs on the network epoch by epoch, every proposal ever made, a live epoch strip, and what hosts were paid and why not everything. Host Setup: simpler steps, pick a GPU setup to see exactly what it needs, and the finished node goes straight into My nodes. Mine it or buy it now counts what hosts were really paid. A larger window and text.
